why: An arXiv preprint (2509.08842, Sept 2025) derives explicit lower bounds for the shortest opaque set of the unit square and unit disc, improving prior bounds by more than a factor of 3 using a stability result of Steinerberger (arXiv:2501.01004, Jan 2025); this directly improves the bound on the problem's own quantity for standard shapes.
